display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per page.

headline.purpose: Section h2. Carried by the sectionHeading utility.

body.purpose: All paragraphs. Light weight + open leading is the editorial signal.

body-small.purpose: Supporting copy in cards and FAQ answers.

label.purpose: All micro-voice: eyebrows, step numbers, date stamps, tags. Mono uppercase, generously tracked.

motion.name: color-150
motion.purpose: Default duration for hover/focus color transitions on links, buttons, nav. Used via Tailwind `transition-colors`.

motion.name: drawer-300
motion.purpose: Mobile nav drawer max-height transition. The only animation on a layout property; justified by being a discrete open/close.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action. Sharp rectangle, ink fill, paper text. Hover shifts to halftone-grey (press, not wash).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111214; color: #e8eaed; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #60656f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111214; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent fill with ink hairline border; inverts to filled ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #111214; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; border: 1px solid #111214; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #111214; color: #e8eaed; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111214; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action. Hairline rule border, muted text. Sharpens to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #60656f; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 18, 20, 0.1); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #111214; color: #111214; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111214; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Grid Card
components.description: Card cell inside a gap-px / bg-rule grid. Negative space between cards IS the divider — cards themselves have no borders.
components.html:
STEP 01

Set it up

Open the cloud app, install the macOS build, or run it locally from source. Pick the surface that fits.

STEP 02

Browse a template

Pick a ready-made agent team. A research desk, a content studio, a briefing bot.
components.css: .ds-card-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1px; background: rgba(17, 18, 20, 0.1); } .ds-card { background: #e8eaed; padding: 32px; } .ds-card-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #60656f; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; color: #111214; margin: 0 0 12px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.65; color: #60656f; margin: 0; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: The mandatory opener of every full-width section. 1px ink dash followed by mono uppercase label. The seal of the system.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-eyebrow-dash { display: block; width: 32px; height: 1px; background: #111214; } .ds-eyebrow-label { font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #60656f; }

components.name: Mono Tag
components.description: Inline uppercase micro-label. Used for step numbers, tags, status markers. Lives at the bottom of cards above a hairline rule.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #60656f; padding: 12px 0 0 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(17, 18, 20, 0.1); }

components.name: Section Rule
components.description: Hairline divider between full-width sections. Constrained to the 1400px content width — never edge-to-edge.
components.css: .ds-hr { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(17, 18, 20, 0.1); height: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link. Color shift only — no underline, no pill, no marker on active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #60656f; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #111214; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #111214; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111214; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a publication that happens to be a website. The vocabulary is borrowed from broadsheet newspapers and technical magazines: paper and ink, hairline rules, mono micro-labels, eyebrow dashes, gap-px grid lines that look like letterpress kerning. Every section reads like a column; every card is a clipping. The reader is invited to scan, not to interpret a UI.

The brand voice this serves is confident, plain, distinctive. The visual system carries the confidence; the copy carries the plainness; together they produce something that doesn't look like another AI-startup landing page. That distance is intentional. The category reflex — gradient hero, glossy cards, Stripe-y blue-purple radials — is the thing this rejects. So is the consumer-app pastel cliché (Notion-cream + soft pink, lifestyle photography). NarraNexus chose editorial over either, on purpose.

Aligned with the internal.netmind.foundation parent brand: Space Grotesk display, Inter body, DM Mono micro-labels, a paper-and-ink palette, sharp corners globally. Sibling NetMind surfaces share these tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-and-ink palette: warm-tinted cool neutrals + one electric blue, used sparingly
Editorial typography: Space Grotesk display, Inter body, DM Mono labels
Sharp corners globally; border-radius: 0 !important is a project-wide rule
Hairline rules and layered neutrals provide all depth; no shadows exist
Mono uppercase micro-labels (eyebrows, tags, dates) carry rhythm
A 72-pixel grid texture sits at 4% opacity behind every page

rules.name: The Ink-or-Blue Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is binary. Press Ink is for confidence and finality. Linotype Blue is for technical specificity. Never both in the same composition.

rules.name: The One-Tenth Blue Rule
rules.body: Linotype Blue may carry no more than ~10% of a screen at full strength. Larger surface uses appear only as /8 – /30 alpha washes (e.g. architecture-layer tinting) so the blue stays punctuation, not fill.

rules.name: The No-True-White Rule
rules.body: #ffffff is forbidden. The paper is always slightly warm-cool grey. Equivalent for ink: #000000 is forbidden; the ink is #111214.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every full-width section opens with a horizontal hairline w-8 h-px bg-ink followed by a mono uppercase eyebrow. The dash + label is the section's seal — non-negotiable.

rules.name: The 300-Weight Body Rule
rules.body: Body copy is Inter 300. Inter 400 looks too heavy against Space Grotesk 700; Inter 500 looks like Material Design. The weight gap between body (300) and headline (700) is what gives the page its editorial quiet.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Micro Rule
rules.body: Anything that wants to whisper goes into DM Mono uppercase — never smaller sans, never italic, never a brighter color. Italics are forbidden by default; mono is the system's italic.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not lift. Hover does not raise. Focus does not glow softly. Where lift would be the reflex, change a color, change a weight, or add a hairline rule. Box-shadows are prohibited.

rules.name: The Gap-Is-The-Rule Rule
rules.body: When dividing cards in a grid, use gap-px over a bg-rule parent. Never put borders on the cards themselves; the negative space does the work.

dos: Do open every section with the dash-and-eyebrow opener (1px dash + mono uppercase label in Halftone Grey).
Do divide cards with gap-px over a bg-rule parent. The negative space is the divider.
Do keep body copy at Inter 300, 15px, line-height 1.8. The editorial signal lives in the weight + leading.
Do confine Linotype Blue to technical-emphasis surfaces (architecture diagrams, data viz). At full strength it stays under 10% of a screen.
Do use mono uppercase labels (DM Mono, tracking-widest) for every micro-voice: eyebrows, step numbers, date stamps, tags.
Do prefer hairline rules and tonal layering for depth.
Do match what the PDF asked for: concise three-block layouts where the format earns its place. The 3-card pattern is a tool, not a default.
donts: Don't use generic AI-startup SaaS aesthetic. No gradient heroes, no glossy cards with subtle shadows, no Stripe-y radial backgrounds, no hero-metric templates, no blue-purple gradient text.
Don't use consumer-app pastel cliché. No Notion-cream + soft pink, no friendly-but-bland rounded cards, no lifestyle photography, no smiling stock illustrations.
Don't use dev-tool framework marketing. No dense code snippets above the fold, no 'for builders by builders' copy.
Don't use AI sci-fi. No dark mode + neon + glassmorphism.
Don't use #ffffff or #000000. Paper is always #e8eaed. Ink is always #111214.
Don't use border-radius. Globally banned via * { border-radius: 0 !important }. If a corner needs softening, the answer is more whitespace.
Don't use box-shadows. Use hairline rules or layered neutrals.
Don't use side-stripe borders. No border-left: 4px solid accents.
Don't use gradient text. Solid color; emphasis via weight or size.
Don't use em dashes. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't add icons just to fill space. 24px stroke icons are allowed in cards where they advance scanability.
Don't add Layout / Motion / Responsive top-level sections to this file.
